source.precedence: Later explicit corrections in DESIGN.md supersede earlier descriptions. Token primitives remain in DESIGN.md frontmatter.

currentGuidance.heading: Latest interaction preferences
currentGuidance.body: Monthly editions are surprises: Preferences has no edition picker, preview/apply button, or preview banner. Calendar-based automatic selection and the internal QA presentation hook remain. This supersedes the earlier user-facing preview description. Secondary action buttons use a theme-derived background, visible 1px boundary, rounded corners, 44px minimum height, explicit hover/focus/disabled states, and no underline; this includes shelf/history/edit/remove and demo return actions.

currentGuidance.heading: Current ghost direction: stationary
currentGuidance.body: The user stopped the rotating ghost animation. Remove both the ambient orbit and the success-time ghost turn. Keep the layered illustration in a fixed resting pose; progress and reward feedback continue. This supersedes all earlier ghost dive/orbit directions.

currentGuidance.heading: Daily priority and completion frame
currentGuidance.body:
Active overview cards remain visible after daily success. Stable sorting places pending actions before completed-today habits, then rest-day habits. A compact status badge in the summary identifies pending/done/rest; a completed card gains an inset line in its existing goal color. Never desaturate, recolor or dim the amulet to indicate daily state. Group headers retain project totals and add today's completed/scheduled habit count. On mobile preserve the viewed dream through reordering; the next forward action from a newly completed card goes to pending work, without changing carousel height.

Amulet objects are stationary across editions and states, including after a successful check. Disable object transforms/animations and their ambient bubble motion while preserving progress charge colors and brightness. This supersedes earlier potion stirring and lantern rocking; independent completion scenes remain unchanged.

currentGuidance.heading: TD monogram and seasonal hat
currentGuidance.body:
The fixed brand is a warm, rounded custom td ligature with an independent spark, authored in `web/shared/brand.js`. In the site header it inherits theme text/accent colors and gains one edition-specific hat perched on the t; keep its base geometry and spark unchanged. The SVG is 46 × 49px on desktop and 38 × 41px on mobile, with no logo animation. Hat silhouettes are presentation-only and follow the existing monthly edition lifecycle. Do not reveal future hat/edition artwork in user-facing previews.

The favicon, opaque 180/192/512px installation PNGs and compact login image contain the plain td-and-spark monogram on the same fixed plum background. Never put the seasonal hat in these smaller identities or change them on month boundaries. The wordmark remains lowercase and readable, with a descriptive accessible home link.

Seasonal card consistency: overview cards use one full-width column with six shared rows, irrespective of the edition's earlier showcase layout. Edition-specific columns cannot place card sections. All editions' amulets gain saturation and brightness with earned progress and stay still. Incomplete archived dreams use their creation edition's artwork with the archive's grayscale treatment.

currentGuidance.heading: Perceptible scenic motion in all editions
currentGuidance.body:
October's foliage breeze is now 8.5 seconds, from −0.65° to +1.05°, with small
translations and clearer lantern flame/light variation. This supersedes the
original eleven-second, nearly imperceptible cycle. Preserve the shooting stars.

The eleven other rooms use source-coordinate effect maps in `ui/magic.js`.
Native layers add localized candle/lantern light, rising cup steam, window water
light/rain, distant reflection, passing mist, daylight or pollen according to
each illustration. Avoid moving books, furniture or card amulets. Match the
existing illustration width of max(viewport, scene height × scene ratio), its
centered desktop positioning and 64% mobile crop. All effects share manual,
dialog, document-visibility, offscreen and reduced-motion controls. Only the
active edition mounts its layer; no new raster assets or future-image requests
are needed for these ambient overlays.

currentGuidance.heading: Consistent seasonal destinations
currentGuidance.body:
All four main destinations and both collection subviews share the active edition's sky and ambient layer. Only the home shows the welcome copy. Other destinations expose 96px of scenery below the header (64px mobile), then use opaque themed sheets with a thin boundary and 16px corners for readable content. Desktop navigation uses the same opaque themed surface across tabs; mobile keeps the shared bottom navigation. Today and collection sheets inherit background, text, muted, line and accent tokens, including collection buttons and locked album slots. Preserve the wooden shelf, portrait and paper-book materials. This supersedes the previous Today/Shelf scene suppression and fixed collection shell palette.

### November scenery framing

Preserve the original underwater library artwork. Desktop adds a directional teal shade behind the welcome copy while keeping the ocean side open. At widths up to 560px, the scene uses a 740px-wide atlas at 28% horizontal position so shelves, staircase and ocean share the crop. Leave 88px above the home welcome copy for an unobstructed glimpse of the room, then fade the scene to the theme background before the atlas object row. The scenic animation stage follows the same width and anchor. Other editions keep their existing framing.

currentGuidance.heading: Unboxed group headings
currentGuidance.body:
The user approved the preview with simple Big Dream headings on the existing library scenery, removing the enclosing cover, spine, inset outline, cover artwork layer and book emblem. Preserve the current gallery/card geometry and 582px template. Keep each card's own boundary. The 56px cord carries the literary detail through paper bookmark shapes, a fine inset rule, a small existing leaf icon and warm clips. Use active theme tokens; keep only symbols visible and retain accessible dream titles. This supersedes the bound-volume group presentation.

The user permits reducing the summaries below Big Dream names when space is tight. Mobile summaries use 11px type with a 15px line height and compact spacing; keep the group name prominent and all card dimensions fixed.

currentGuidance.heading: Responsive pending bookmarks
currentGuidance.body:
All currently visible dreams have a stable bookmark slot. Pending bookmarks use a dashed outline and theme-muted symbol on transparent paper; completed ones use the existing filled paper style. Keep both clickable and label their state for assistive technology. The strip stays 56px tall with fixed 44px-wide targets at every viewport size, including large collections. Horizontal overflow stays within the strip, with edge fades indicating more bookmarks. Recording/undo preserves its horizontal position and never changes card dimensions.

Mobile bottom navigation uses a 45px base height (44px targets plus the border), with 18px outline symbols, compact label spacing, no extra vertical container padding, and the full bottom safe-area inset. Update viewport/body fallback reservations together; the chapter layout still follows measured navigation height. Cards retain their fixed 582px template.

For the user's second request to shorten the bottom menu, switch each destination to a single horizontal icon/label line: 16px symbols, 10px labels, 4px gap and 36px-high buttons in a 37px base bar. Keep all four labels and the pending badge, preserve bottom safe-area padding, and keep the dream card at 582px.

Correction from the user's screenshot: keep the original navigation content sizes (20px icons, 11px labels, 9px count badge) and stacked layout. Achieve the 37px bar only through zero vertical button padding and zero icon-label gap. Preserve the safe area and fixed cards. Regression checks assert those exact sizes so later menu-height changes cannot silently shrink the content.

On the mobile dream chapter, keep the toolbar sticky at 8px inside the safe-area-protected scroll container, with a transparent background and no backdrop blur. The full-size brand remains below the iPhone status area while the cards scroll. Top and bottom inset simulation verifies this without modifying personal data.

The logo toolbar has no opaque background strip. Bottom navigation symbols are now 24px at the user’s request; labels remain 11px with a 12px line height so the existing 37px bar and safe-area padding stay unchanged.

The transparent logo toolbar now stays in normal flow rather than sticky positioning, avoiding overlap with the bookmark cord or card content while scrolling. This supersedes the pinned-toolbar direction.

The bottom menu must center its controls in the whole visible bar. Use `--nav-inset: min(8px, var(--bottom-safe-area))`, split equally into top and bottom padding. With a 34px device inset, the bar is 45px tall and has 4px above and below the 36px controls (plus the top border). Assert equal padding and vertical center alignment in QA; do not shrink the 24px symbols or 11px labels. Reserve the same effective height for chapter/body geometry.

Final user adjustment: use 8px vertical padding on both sides of the centered navigation controls (`--nav-inset:16px`). Total bar height is 53px, with the same 24px icons, 11px labels and 36px control content. Device safe-area values must not reintroduce an asymmetric empty lower strip.

currentGuidance.heading: Reward gestures and the journey illustration
currentGuidance.body:
Use a finite hierarchy: a drawn item check and 500ms contribution gesture; a short local acknowledgment in diaries; merging checks for a finished daily list; inscribed double-ring milestones, record and return honors in the existing seasonal scene; a 700ms seal return to the grid; a single accent-cord drawing on a fully completed day. Never animate the card amulets, move card sections, or add card height. Best-sequence badges use the second reserved caption line/space. Unscheduled and explicitly skipped dates preserve sequence continuity. Regret/undo cancels particles and removes unearned visuals; ordinary rendering never replays a reward.

The journey image reuses an available seasonal illustration in a 4×4 reveal with partially filled pieces, so progress advances even between whole pieces. Details and selected shelf books expose the full image through a disclosure; completion scenes use a small clickable thumbnail within the existing art area. The completed book retains its symbol, creation color slot and a small numbered seal. All new controls retain 44px targets, active theme colors and readable static outcomes. Reduced/manual motion removes travel and merging while preserving the check, day seal, reveal and honor. Preferences contains an isolated eight-scenario rehearsal using demo records only.

currentGuidance.heading: Forward-looking practice window
currentGuidance.body:
Preserve the 2×7 grid and 582px card. Today occupies position eleven (index ten), followed by three empty future dates. Future dates remain empty; only the most recently earned milestone carries a numbered double-ring seal. Archive strips end at their actual deadline. Impulse strips center the current full-day interval in the same position and mark pre-start slots as rest. Readable reward ink uses the active accent on dark editions and the active text color on light editions; seal backgrounds remain the theme surface.

All-edition layout validation also removes the legacy seasonal margin from the reserved title wrapper. The actual title and its subtitle (2px separation) remain inside the heading rows, so two-line notes do not overlap the daily-state badge. Card dimensions, amulet area, date/progress/action slots and swipe height remain fixed. The reward theme matrix checks this boundary as well as shared title/progress alignment.

currentGuidance.heading: Embroidered achievements and success scenes
currentGuidance.body: Collection adds a Conquistas subview with a latest-achievement row and edition sections. Use open three-column medal groups on mobile and six columns on desktop, with inline expandable conditions and dated earned records. The current edition shows locked outlines; historical editions show only earned badges. Keep labels outside the medal readable in active-theme text; each earned medal preserves its original edition surface/accent. Fine dashed outer/inner seams and the existing outline symbol suggest embroidery without raster assets or texture noise. Numerals use the established serif at regular weight: 16px in the practice grid and 21–28px in success seals. The outer seam reveals once with a short clip animation, disabled for reduced/manual motion. The completed-dream scene removes the duplicate book and presents a larger stitched badge below the seasonal illustration. Existing card geometry, scenery, shelf and writer collection remain intact.

currentGuidance.heading: Visible end of the practice grid
currentGuidance.body:
When a non-impulse habit can reach its remaining target within the visible window, show the target number in a dashed outline on its projected final scheduled day. This includes today when five of six consecutive days are done. It is a forecast, not an earned seal: success replaces it with the existing achieved milestone. Respect scheduled weekdays, skipped dates and recorded failures; recalculate after correction or a broken sequence. Hide circles after the actual or projected finish while preserving their empty grid slots, the 2×7 layout, today's index and the 582px card. This supersedes the requirement that all three future slots always show empty circles; no future success is inferred.

The final-day circle also carries eight short static rays in the dream color, around the dashed forecast and the earned final seal. Keep them outside the circle without moving neighboring dates or changing grid geometry.

components.name: Compact calendar day
components.description: This supersedes wrapping stickers inside day cells. The month uses equal 48px day targets (56px desktop, 44px narrow phones), only date numbers, and theme-accent tint from 6% at zero completion to 38% at full completion. Future and unscheduled empty days are neutral; today has an inset outline, selection adds an underlined numeral and distinct border. Labels expose counts and percentage independently of color. A small discrete scale explains intensity. Below the month, the selected date shows a count and every completed dream as a 58px sticker with its preserved title in a three-column wrapping collection. A disclosure retains all remaining records and existing date editors. Filter and month navigation retain keyboard focus; selecting a date never opens a modal.

narrative.overview:
A biblioteca dos pequenos feitiços is a nocturnal literary garden: moonlit plum, warm paper, copper light, illustrated potion glass, pumpkins, and friendly ghosts. Handmade richness belongs in the working components as well as the scenery; clear labels, readable progress, and generous controls keep the daily ritual practical.

Literature is permanent; October’s Halloween appearance is seasonal. Twelve prepared editions span October 2026 through September 2027, selected automatically by the São Paulo calendar. Their compositions, objects, materials, light, and ambient effects change substantially within a cozy, handmade literary refuge. Future worlds remain surprises unless the user explicitly opens a preview; creating editions beyond the finite schedule requires new authored work.
keyCharacteristics: Handmade seasonal illustration within a permanent literary identity.
Bookish display typography paired with plain, readable controls.
Tonal cards and restrained light, with progress expressed through illustrated talismans.

rules.name: Literary World
rules.body: Every seasonal world must connect to literature; its appearance and metaphor may change while personal records remain intact. The permanent emotional anchor is a cozy library: intimate, welcoming, bookish, and handmade. Monthly editions must vary composition and illustrated elements substantially, not merely recolor the current template. Lighting, materials, objects, and celebrations can change freely within this anchor; everyday controls remain understandable. Follow Brazilian autumn, winter, and spring, without summer-themed editions; preserve Halloween in October and Christmas in December.

rules.name: Honest Light
rules.body: Illustrated charge follows total practice progress; decorative light never substitutes for numeric progress or reward status.

rules.name: Current seasonal destinations
rules.body:
All four main destinations and both collection subviews share the active edition's sky and ambient layer. Only the home shows the welcome copy. Other destinations expose 96px of scenery below the header (64px mobile), then use opaque themed sheets with a thin boundary and 16px corners for readable content. Desktop navigation uses the same opaque themed surface across tabs; mobile keeps the shared bottom navigation. Today and collection sheets inherit background, text, muted, line and accent tokens, including collection buttons and locked album slots. Preserve the wooden shelf, portrait and paper-book materials. This supersedes the previous Today/Shelf scene suppression and fixed collection shell palette.

### November scenery framing

Preserve the original underwater library artwork. Desktop adds a directional teal shade behind the welcome copy while keeping the ocean side open. At widths up to 560px, the scene uses a 740px-wide atlas at 28% horizontal position so shelves, staircase and ocean share the crop. Leave 88px above the home welcome copy for an unobstructed glimpse of the room, then fade the scene to the theme background before the atlas object row. The scenic animation stage follows the same width and anchor. Other editions keep their existing framing.

dos: Do connect every future world to literature and carry its character into components and interactions.
Do preserve goal identity, check-in dates, total progress, targets, and redemption state when changing a theme.
Do keep rewards, remaining practice days, and undo actions explicit; total progress survives missed days.
Do keep demonstrations labeled and separate from personal records.
Do retain visible state with reduced motion and legible mobile form controls.
donts: Don't replace rich handmade seasonal artwork with generic flat symbols alone.
Don't make a streak the measure of total earned practice.
Don't imply that new editions are generated automatically beyond September 2027.
Don't preload future artwork, reveal surprise images in main chat, or open previews without explicit action.
Don't add scattered decorative phrases; retain headings, subtitles, instructions, status, and data.
Don't let illustration obscure task labels, progress, reward names, or controls.
